channel.title: Ghana - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Ghana, every source cited.

item.title: Four arrested for leasing land to illegal miners
item.description: Unit committee members allegedly collected money from galamsey operators for land near a collapsed bridge.

item.title: Ghana ambassador condoles family of teen shot in New York
item.description: Javits Badu Nkansah Frimpong, 15, was shot dead in the Bronx after moving to the US for a better future.

item.title: Police hunt suspect after two shot dead in Sakumono
item.description: George and Irene Atuguba were killed following an alleged GH¢500,000 debt dispute.

item.title: GRA named PR Organisation of the Year
item.description: The Ghana Revenue Authority received the award at the 2026 National PR Summit in Koforidua.

item.title: National Theatre hosts Funworld 2026 for breast cancer awareness
item.description: The event combines education, entertainment, and competition to raise awareness of mental well-being and breast cancer among schoolchildren.
